title: Run VOICE.md/AGENTS.md coverage audit for Anth.us and Chattic.us

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Only Pilobolus has had the full read-VOICE.md-line-by-line audit so far
(this session), which found real gaps (noEmojis unset, incomplete
self-naming bans, missing jargon words, missing Sources-list pattern --
see prior comments on LIM-a482f8). Same methodology needs to run for:

- Anth.us: AGENTS.md (now mostly a pointer after this session's DRY
  cleanup) + src/site-content/README.md's Voice section, against
  publications/anthus/style-profile.yml.
- Chattic.us: content/VOICE.md against
  .claude/skills/publication-writing/style-profile.yml (the migrated
  profile from this session) -- especially worth checking since that
  profile was translated from the old bespoke rules.yml rather than
  audited fresh against VOICE.md's full prose, so it may have inherited
  the same kind of gap (stated-in-prose, not mechanically checked) that
  the bespoke script itself might already have had.

Approach that worked: read the whole VOICE.md, list every sentence that
sounds like a rule (not just the ones already in bulleted 'banned' lists),
check each against style-profile.yml, and sanity-check any new
banned-phrase/lexicon additions against ALL currently published content
for that publication before shipping (caught what would have been false
positives twice this session).
